Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the metric values for different model variants in an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variants” and displays categories as text: “Full model”, “w/o Prompt”, “w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Attention”, and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66, with tick marks at intervals of 2. There are three lines displayed on the plot. The first line, colored gray, is marked with circular data points and represents “Precision”, starting at a value of 61.06 at “Full model” and decreasing to 57.74 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The second line, colored light blue, is marked with triangular data points and represents “Recall”, starting at a value of 65.78 at “Full model” and decreasing to 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The third line, colored purple, is marked with diamond data points and represents “F1-score”, starting at a value of 64.06 at “Full model” and decreasing to 59.67 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”.
